description: Declared mutants of v8-engine-platform-path-dialog (docs/architecture/platform-sdl.md, Design Invariant 10). Run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/framework-rework/scripts/platform_path_dialog_mutations.json --build-dir <a tree with the SDL platform and BUILD_TESTING=ON>, with SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy in the runner's environment. A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message. The lifetime mutants that only a sanitizer sees are in platform_path_dialog_mutations-asan.json.

mutants.what: The callback drops the answer instead of handing it to the mailbox
The answer does not carry the request's tag
Answers are handed out newest first instead of in arrival order
TakePathDialogAnswers copies the answers and leaves them for the next call
A cancelled dialog is reported as failed
Showing a dialog inside an observer is not an asserted operation
The dialog callback loses noexcept (an exception could cross SDL's stack)
mutants.find: void SDLCALL OnPathDialogClosed(void* userdata, const char* const* files, int) noexcept {
mutants.replace: void SDLCALL OnPathDialogClosed(void* userdata, const char* const* files, int) {
mutants.expect: PathDialogCallback|invalid conversion|cannot convert|cannot initialize|no viable conversion|no matching

mutants.what: The neutral header forward-declares SDL's filter type (G2 must report it)
mutants.find:

mutants.what: A Failed answer ends the request, so the legacy dialog's answer on Windows is lost
zenity's empty path for a cancelled dialog is reported as chosen
A request with no valid kind reaches SDL instead of failing a GYO_ASSERT
The real launcher does not hand a save request to SDL

mutants.replace: functions.openFile(callback, userdata, window, filters, filterCount, defaultLocation, true);
